I really enjoy hearing Jay Hatfield's comments and observations on the market. He is absolutely right that Keynesian economics is a bad model to follow, and our government loves it. The Austrian model is where we should be. If you look through the history of this and the last century since the Federal Reserve was established in 1913, we have had more crashes, severe recessions, and depressions than in the 19th century. The Fed and the Keynesian model are killing the US economy. I own a nice position in Jay's PFFA fund!
There's a good chance in 5 years, 10 year yields will be 3% and oil will be below 80$.
After one month, it is possible to see how the technologies are performing...
